LESSON: LIGHT ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.8: Light ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Light ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about different sources of light in the immediate environment,
2. play with shadows 150
3. appreciate uses of light in the immediate environment poems related to light working areas Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about different sources of light in the immediate environment,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about different sources of light in the immediate environment,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. play with shadows 150
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to play with shadows 150. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate uses of light in the immediate environment poems related to light working areas Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate uses of light in the immediate environment poems related to light working areas Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Light ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Light ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Light ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: talk about different sources of light in the immediate environment,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Light ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Light ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about different sources of light in the immediate environment,
2. play with shadows 150
3. appreciate uses of light in the immediate environment poems related to light working areas Core-Competences to be developed:

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
